The `source` array uses a predictable GitHub release tarball URL based on the declared `pkgver`, and checksums are provided for all sources. No remote code execution, data exfiltration, or unsafe side effects can occur merely by sourcing this file.

This PKGBUILD adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and poses no risk during metadata extraction.
